'''Tulak Hord's ritual''' was a powerful [[The Force/Legends|Force]] rite developed by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Tulak Hord]]. The ritual was an act of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith sorcery]] that allowed the performing [[Sith sorcerer]] to conduct an act of [[essence transfer]]&mdash;to move one's spirit out of their own body and into the body of another. [[Darth Zash]] performed the ritual around [[3643 BBY]].
